data.name: Maahnoor
data.gender_notes: Maahnoor is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahna', meaning 'to value, appreciate, or treasure'. In Islamic culture, the name Maahnoor symbolizes the worth and value of a child in the eyes of their parents and in the sight of God. The name Maahnoor carries the meaning “Precious, Valuable, Treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maahnoor usually hope their child will grow to embody precious, valuable, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maahnoor total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
